newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: ING nine month net profit up 24 percent.
newsitem.headline: ING nine month net profit up 24 percent.

text.p: Dutch banking and insurance group ING Groep NV (ING) on Thursday reported nine-month net profits up 24 percent to 2.34 billion guilders ($1.4 billion) in 1996 from 1.88 billion guilders in the same period last year.
Analysts had been looking for strong profits of between 2.27 billion and 2.55 billion guilders.
Net earnings per share rose to 3.23 guilders from 2.75 a year ago and ING said it expected a clear increase in per share earnings over the full year 1996 compared with 1995.

"Despite the increase in share capital through stock dividends and the conversion of warrants, ING expects, on the basis of the nine month result, that net profits per share over the whole of 1996 will be clearly higher compared to 1995," ING said.

Pre-tax banking and insurance profits at the group both showed strong increases, with insurance profits growing to 1.72 billion guilders from 1.48 billion and banking profits rising to 1.62 billion guilders from 1.28 billion.

ING shares on the Amsterdam stock exchange which had traded down during the morning, remained in negative territory after the announcement, off 0.70 guilders to 58.30 at 1120 GMT. -- Amsterdam newsroom +31 20 504 5000, Fax +31 20 504 5040 ($ = 1.68 Dutch Guilders)
